purpose: art-direction concepts only; not runtime screenshots or 3D models

prompts.name: adult_animation
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: PREVIEW-ONLY art direction concept for SocialCoach, a browser 3D social conversation rehearsal game. Reference image role: layout and cast roles, NOT final character realism. Reimagine the reference as a polished, clearly stylized 3D animated scene, not a photo and not a real app screenshot. Keep the bright Chinese private dining room, round dining table, three seated Chinese ADULT coworkers: center male manager about 50 in charcoal suit and tie with a reserved, expectant expression; left female senior coworker about 40 with tied hair in a tailored suit, thoughtful and attentive; right younger male coworker about 25 in blue shirt and glasses, a little hesitant. Clearly distinct age, silhouette and personality. Seated eye-level first-person camera facing all three. Simplified but recognizable fish, dumplings, greens, teapot and porcelain on the table. Warm ivory walls, restrained walnut, sage upholstery, bright soft indoor light. Natural connected bodies and plausible five-finger hands. One manager holds a modest stemmed glass correctly. Social tension is subtle and credible, not threatening. Remove all interface overlays, controls, labels, text, logos, watermarks and floating objects. No photographic skin, pores, veins, wet hyperreal eyeballs, alpha hair cards, waxy mannequin skin, corpse-like stiffness, giant anime eyes, toddlers, mascot humans or identical smiling characters. Keep characters, furniture and food at the SAME level of stylization. Wide landscape composition, production-minded clean shapes, sharp eyes and brows, balanced visual density.
Direction A: mature feature-animation 3D. Adults around six-head proportions, heads only mildly enlarged. Soft but deliberately sculpted facial planes, legible brows and eyelids, modest stylized eyes, expressive mouth corners. Hair as clean sculpted masses with a few grouped locks. Matte skin, simplified fabric folds, restrained physically lit materials with coherent rounded bevels. Sophisticated adult appeal, approachable yet capable of projecting authority. No outlines. The room and props use the same rounded, restrained design language.

prompts.name: graphic_toon
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Preview-only SocialCoach art direction B revision. Preserve exactly the adult cast, seating, reserved emotions, room layout, dinner props and perspective from this image. Change ONLY the rendering and surface language to much more graphic, clearly volumetric 3D toon shading: firm two/three-tone shadow bands, restrained clean contour lines, very simple solid hair masses, matte flat-color fabric with NO woven photo texture, broad facial color planes, simplified eyes, no skin microdetail. Apply the SAME clean 3D toon treatment to the room, fish, vegetables, plates and wood; remove photoreal fish scales, food photography and wood grain. Not 2D painting, not a photograph. Keep credible adult proportions and a manager capable of authority, no big chibi heads or giant anime eyes. Bright restrained ivory/sage/walnut palette, no text, no interface, no logos.

prompts.name: soft_handcrafted
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Preview-only SocialCoach art direction C revision. Preserve exactly the three adult coworkers, age contrast, outfits, seating, subtle reserved expressions, room layout and dinner composition. Change ONLY the surface and sculptural rendering language to unmistakable HAND-SCULPTED CLAY 3D: broad handmade hair locks with visible sculpt grooves, softly irregular matte clay faces with modest simple eyes, thick sculpted eyelids and brows, no pores, no realistic skin/eye shaders, NO photographic textile weave. Suits should read as sculpted matte material with clear simple folds. Furniture, fish, dumplings, vegetables and teapot must also look like coherent handmade sculpted props with mild tactile texture, not photographed food or wood. Keep adult six-head-like proportions, professional credibility, five fingers, no babies/chibi, no toy ball heads, no uniform smiles. Soft bright light, warm ivory/sage/walnut, no text, no UI, no logo. The difference from sophisticated feature-animation style must be obvious.
